decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up a board presence of low-cost creatures and utilize ramp spells and mana accelerators to play powerful threats early on. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of aggressive creatures, backed up by support cards that enhance their abilities and generate additional value. The focus is on maintaining pressure and tempo, forcing the opponent to react defensively while the Mono Green Aggro player gains board control and secures a victory through efficient combat and creature synergy.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Deadly Cover-Up, Shoot the Sheriff, and Requiting Hex, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage with cards like Stock Up and Professor Dellian Fel. The mana base is designed to provide the necessary colors to cast the spells in the deck efficiently, while also including utility lands like Underground Mortuary and Gloomlake Verge. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The Azorius Aggro deck focuses on aggressive early game plays using a mix of flying creatures and tempo spells to control the board. Utilizing cards like Aang, Swift Savior and Momo, Friendly Flier for evasive damage, along with disruptive spells like Erode and Daydream to slow down the opponent's game plan. Floodfarm Verge and Starfield Shepherd provide additional support and resilience, while Haliya, Guided by Light offers a powerful finisher. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures such as Quantum Riddler and Steamcore Scholar, supported by cards like Practiced Offense and Starfield Shepherd to apply pressure on the opponent. Nurturing Pixie and Floodfarm Verge help to ramp up mana for bigger threats like Monica Rambeau and Sage of the Skies. The deck also includes control elements like We Say Thee Nay! and Seam Rip to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and control to secure victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Duress, Deadly Cover-Up, and Shoot the Sheriff, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain board control. Cards like Stock Up and Jeskai Revelation provide card draw to keep the player's hand stocked with options. The inclusion of mana fixing lands and powerful spells like Firebending Lesson and Sear allow for flexible and powerful plays to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence with aggressive creatures like Floodpits Drowner, Dream Beavers, and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and disruption using cards like Spell Pierce, Spell Snare, and Requiting Hex. The deck also includes cards like Enduring Curiosity and Tishana's Tidebinder to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. Wan Shi Tong, Librarian and The Wondrous Wasp provide additional utility and control options. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and efficient in its aggression while maintaining card advantage and disruption capabilities.

The deck focuses on using low-cost, aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes a combination of creatures with strong abilities and direct damage spells to control the board and maintain pressure. The inclusion of cards like Soulstone Sanctuary and Realm of Koh provide additional resources and card advantage, while cards like Gollum, Riddle Master and Dark Knight's Greatsword offer late-game finishers to close out games. Overall, the deck aims to control the game early, maintain tempo, and finish off opponents with a lethal combination of creatures and spells.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive and efficient creatures like Greasewrench Goblin and Emberheart Challenger, while dealing direct damage with spells like Burst Lightning and Shock. Tersa Lightshatter and Nova Hellkite provide additional threats that can quickly end the game if not dealt with, while Zhao, the Moon Slayer and Hired Claw offer versatility and resilience. Soulstone Sanctuary helps to boost the aggression of the deck, with support from cards like Channeled Dragonfire and Smaug the Magnificent to maintain tempo and pressure.

This deck focuses on using flying creatures and tempo manipulation to quickly overwhelm opponents and control the battlefield. By combining powerful fliers like Momo, Friendly Flier and Sage of the Skies with cards like Daydream and Quantum Riddler to disrupt opponents' strategies, the deck aims to maintain board control and deal damage efficiently. Utilizing cards like Floodfarm Verge and Springleaf Drum for mana acceleration, as well as some removal options like Erode and Parting Gust, allows the deck to adapt to various situations while maintaining a relentless aggro playstyle.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using creatures and spells that boost their power and give them an edge in combat. The key strategy revolves around quickly ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage to bring out bigger threats like Mossborn Hydra and Sazh's Chocobo. Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer help to further enhance the power and toughness of the creatures, while Escape Tunnel provides evasion. The deck also includes utility cards like Ba Sing Se and Keen-Eyed Curator to provide card advantage and control.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, allowing for fast plays and early aggression. It also utilizes creatures with powerful abilities like Mightform Harmonizer and Surrak, Elusive Hunter to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck includes cards like Escape Tunnel and Snakeskin Veil for protection and evasion, complimented by strong finishers like Mossborn Hydra and Earthbender Ascension. By combining ramp, protection, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient aggression.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Haliya, Guided by Light, and Leonardo, Cutting Edge to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Leyline of Hope and Erode to control the opponent's resources. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on and maintain that pressure throughout the game. Additionally, cards like Starting Town and Concealed Courtyard provide mana consistency to ensure a smooth curve of plays.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana and cast Omniscience, allowing you to play spells from your hand for free. The combo involves using cards like Ashling, Rekindled and Uthros, Titanic Godcore to generate additional mana and control the board. Kavaron, Memorial World and Stock Up provide card advantage, while Ill-Timed Explosion can disrupt your opponent's strategy. Your win condition is to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures like North Wind Avatar and Marang River Regent, while also having protection with cards like Spell Pierce. The deck thrives on high mana generation and explosive plays to secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively overwhelming opponents with a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful combat tricks. By utilizing efficient creatures like Fanatical Firebrand and Stadium Headliner, while also having access to strong removal like Burst Lightning, the deck aims to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent early on. The inclusion of cards like Ojer Axonil and Hexing Squelcher adds versatility and control options, while high-impact creatures like The Queen of Dale and Raphael, Tough Turtle provide late-game finishers to secure the win.

This deck focuses on utilizing a synergy between various airbending creatures and spells to create a powerful combo. By utilizing cards like Michelangelo's Technique and Aang, at the Crossroads, players aim to set up a strong defense while also attacking their opponent. The key strategy is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Floodfarm Verge to bring out powerful airbending creatures like Appa, Steadfast Guardian. By controlling the board and maximizing the potential of airbending abilities, players can overwhelm their opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on using graveyard recursion and combo pieces to quickly bring back powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes cards that allow for card draw, hand disruption, and protection spells to ensure the combo can be successful. The main goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures that can quickly turn the tide of the game in your favor.
